Premium subscriptions

Monthly and annual plans renew automatically unless canceled. Apple displays the localized price, billing period and any introductory offer before you confirm. For eligible subscribers, the seven-day trial converts to the selected paid subscription unless canceled. To avoid the next charge, cancel at least 24 hours before the trial or current period ends.

Manage or cancel through Tidiva’s Settings → Subscription, or through your Apple Account subscriptions. Apple handles refund requests through Report a Problem.

Lifetime access

Lifetime Premium is a one-time, non-consumable purchase. Use Restore purchases with the same Apple Account to recover eligible purchases.
